pub fn calibrate(
    beans: i32,
    ratio: i32,
    water_offset: i32,
    batches: i32,
    temperature: i32,
    target_temperature: i32,
    grind: i32,
    target_grind: i32,
) -> i32 {

        + (temperature - target_temperature) * 2
        + (grind - target_grind) * 5
}
